headline: OpenAI relaunches ChatGPT Health feature with expanded access
summary: The AI chatbot can now connect to your Apple Health data to provide summaries and insights.
details: OpenAI is bringing back its Health feature for ChatGPT, allowing the AI to access and analyze data from Apple Health on iPhones. This relaunch aims to provide users with new ways to understand their health information through AI.

The feature enables ChatGPT to call upon Health's summary tool, potentially answering questions about lab results or other health metrics. Users will be prompted to grant permission for ChatGPT to use their health data.

This integration was first announced in 2023 but is now being relaunched with expanded access. OpenAI is making significant claims about the capabilities of this feature, though specific details on its full functionality are still emerging.

The ability to query personal health data through an AI chatbot raises questions about privacy and data security. OpenAI has stated that user data will be handled with care, but users should remain aware of the permissions they grant.
